_comment: Demo data for ?demo=1. Every value below is INVENTED. It is not anyone's health data, it is not derived from anyone's health data, and it should not be read as a target, a benchmark, or a reference range. It exists so the dashboard has something to render without a backend. If you fork this, do not replace these with your own real numbers in a committed file.
_vitalsComment: Generated as a smooth synthetic series so the charts have shape. Deliberately unremarkable values well inside published population ranges.
